iṭṭiya: Iṭṭiya [yādicchakanāma] Iṭṭiya Thera. During the reign of King Ashoka, Ashin Moggaliputta Tissathar was one of the seven people who led the missionaries to Thihaul Island when he sent missionaries to nine divisions.
